programs.title: NHK NEWS 7
programs.desc: NEWS7 is NHK's flagship domestic evening news program, bringing you the latest from our Tokyo studio. It's presented with English audio on NHK World for our international viewers.

programs.title: Today's Close Up
programs.desc: . A new form of poverty is quietly spreading among young people in Japan. Barely making ends meet through one-off jobs, many don't have a stable home, which hinders their access to public assistance. Hiroko Kuniya, Takeshige Morimoto.

programs.title: Newsroom Tokyo
programs.desc: . NEWSROOM TOKYO dives deeper into the day's news with insight and analysis, from the perspective of Japan and the rest of Asia. We put a spotlight on what you need to know to understand the issues. Yuko Fukushima, Aiko Doden, Takafumi Terui, Shoichiro Beppu, Hideki Nakayama, Takuma Yoshioka, Koichiro Tanaka, Chan-ju Kim, Abhishek Dhulia, Aki Shibuya.

programs.title: Direct Talk
programs.desc: , Episode 261. Ito Junji, famed horror manga artist, draws inspiration from everyday fears, urban legends, and the uncanny. He turns ordinary objects and natural phenomena into eerie, unsettling visions, crafting stories of grotesque, psychological horror that linger. Gene Otani.

programs.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo 10min.
programs.desc: Kiriboshi daikon-daikon radish that's cut and sun-dried to preserve it. Both tasty and nutritious, it's gaining traction as a health food. Discover more about its unique texture and versatility.

programs.title: Ukiyoe Edo-life
programs.desc: . It's summer, and a group of women have gathered at the local well to do laundry in the shade. We learn about the different techniques and tools they used to wash and dry different types of kimonos.
